scientific_role: Prospective external confirmation motivated by the already-observed synthetic final-rigor v2 result. This protocol is not retroactive evidence for the synthetic study and must remain valid if the real-market result is null, adverse, or reversed.
primary_question: Does the memory-enabled full model reduce out-of-sample eigenspectrum prediction error relative to the otherwise matched no-memory ablation on a separately frozen real-equity dataset?

primary.practical_effect_rule: The full model must reduce pooled test eig_nmse by at least 5 percent relative to no_memory across the frozen evaluation package.
primary.uncertainty_rule: The upper endpoint of a predeclared two-stage paired bootstrap 95 percent interval for full-minus-no_memory pooled eig_nmse must be below zero. The frozen analysis resamples the five exact seeds with replacement, then independently moving-block-resamples chronological test windows within each frozen fold using 20-window blocks, 10000 resamples, and bootstrap seed 20260906.

asset_universe.selection_note: Fixed before real-market outcome access to provide broad-market, size, growth, and long-history sector exposures while avoiding later-launched sector funds that would shorten the common sample.

candidate_date_span.calendar_policy: Use only dates present for every frozen asset after source-specific adjustment. Do not forward-fill returns or prices across missing observations.

data_freeze_requirements.price_field: adjusted close or provider-equivalent total-return-consistent field; exact provider semantics must be documented before freeze
data_freeze_requirements.return_definition: close-to-close log return computed only from consecutive retained observations after common-date intersection
data_freeze_requirements.corporate_action_rule: Use the frozen provider's adjustment field; do not hand-edit splits or dividends after outcome access.
data_freeze_requirements.missing_data_rule: Intersect to common dates first; no forward fill, backward fill, interpolation, or asset substitution.
data_freeze_requirements.date_order_rule: Canonical ISO YYYY-MM-DD, unique, strictly increasing.
forbidden: changing the asset universe after seeing model outcomes
dropping adverse dates, seeds, variants, or folds
replacing the provider snapshot after outcome access except for documented corruption with the prior bytes retained
using test outcomes to tune preprocessing, hyperparameters, thresholds, or bootstrap settings

model_and_training_policy.source_basis: Start from the frozen synthetic final-rigor v2 architecture/training configuration rather than retuning on real test outcomes.
model_and_training_policy.seed_policy: No substitution, favorable-seed reruns, or dropping. Any deterministic failure remains in the evidence ledger and must be explained.
model_and_training_policy.hyperparameter_changes_before_freeze: Only changes required to make the frozen real-market window counts executable may be made, and every such change must be finalized before outcome access. No outcome-driven architecture or optimizer tuning is allowed.

source_freeze_requirements.source_commit_rule: Bind one exact lowercase 40-hex prospective source commit after all pre-outcome implementation changes are merged and before any model/test outcome access.

evaluation_design.type: chronological expanding-window confirmation with purged boundaries
evaluation_design.purge_rule: Training targets must end on or before train_end. Validation and test retain only windows whose full context and full target are contained inside their declared date interval. Boundary-crossing windows are omitted.

label_generation.regime_proxy: For each retained date, stress = 0.5 * cross-sectional mean absolute return + 0.5 * cross-sectional return standard deviation.
label_generation.regime_threshold_fit_surface: Fit both stress quantiles using training rows only, through the final row consumed by a training target window. Validation and test returns must not influence the fitted thresholds.
label_generation.regime_application: Apply the two frozen training-fitted thresholds unchanged to all validation and test rows.
label_generation.event_threshold_fit_surface: Compute window salience only on retained training windows using the training-fitted regime labels, then fit the event threshold at the 0.70 training-window quantile.
label_generation.future_invariance_requirement: Changing any validation/test return while holding the complete training surface fixed must not alter training regime thresholds, training regime labels, or the event threshold.

fold_runner.pre_outcome_mode: --plan-only may materialize exact purged fold/window identities from the frozen normalized CSV without executing any model or reading test outcomes.
fold_runner.execution_gate: Any model/test execution requires protocol status FROZEN_PRE_OUTCOME_AUTHORIZED, execution_authorized=true, frozen raw/normalized/input-receipt hashes, a 40-hex prospective source commit, the frozen dependency-lock SHA-256, the exact fold-runner SHA-256, and independent pre-outcome review approval.
fold_runner.retained_evidence: For every exact fold x seed x variant run, retain strictly increasing test window_index, per-window mean eigenvalue squared error, positive target energy, train-only regime thresholds, train-only event threshold, protocol SHA-256, and normalized CSV SHA-256. The runner then fail-closes unless full/no_memory window identities and target energies agree exactly across all five seeds before writing primary_analysis_input.json.

evaluation_design.fold_note: Purged fold construction, train-only label generation, and a fail-closed fold-level runner are implemented. Exact row/window counts must still be materialized from the frozen normalized CSV before training; the dependency lock is already frozen prospectively, while the final prospective source commit remains to be bound before authorization.
evaluation_design.test_access_rule: Do not inspect aggregate, window-level, or seed-level test metrics until the normalized dataset bytes, exact fold runner, analysis implementation, source commit, dependency lock, and authorization receipt are frozen and timestamped.

analysis_freeze_requirements.paired_unit: Chronological test window, paired across full and no_memory and across the exact five seeds; each bootstrap replicate resamples seeds with replacement and moving-block-resamples windows independently within each fold.
analysis_freeze_requirements.primary_endpoint_definition: For each system, pooled_eig_nmse equals the sum of per-window mean squared eigenvalue error, after averaging matched seed errors at each selected window, divided by the sum of per-window mean squared target eigenvalue energy across the three frozen test folds.
analysis_freeze_requirements.bootstrap_method: two-stage paired seed plus within-fold moving-block bootstrap
analysis_freeze_requirements.block_length_rationale: Approximately one trading month; fixed prospectively before provider snapshot freeze or model outcome access.
analysis_freeze_requirements.ci_method: percentile interval using NumPy linear quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975
analysis_freeze_requirements.multiple_testing: Primary inference is only full versus no_memory on pooled_eig_nmse. Other endpoints/comparisons are descriptive unless a separate multiplicity rule is frozen before outcome access.
analysis_freeze_requirements.required_input_schema: Three exact folds F1/F2/F3; exact seeds 7/19/31/43/59 for full and no_memory; strictly increasing non-overlapping window indices; positive target energy; finite nonnegative per-window eigenvalue squared errors.

authorization_blockers: freeze provider/source snapshot and raw-source hash
materialize the exact common-date adjusted-return CSV and source-bound receipt with scripts/prepare_real_market_input.py
materialize and retain the exact pre-outcome fold_plan.json from the frozen normalized CSV
bind the exact prospective source commit and copy the already-frozen dependency-lock and fold-runner SHA-256 identities into the authorization object
independent pre-outcome review of the completed protocol and immutable review bundle
claim_boundary: A passing real-market confirmation may support only the predeclared primary comparison on this frozen ETF universe/date design. It does not establish trading alpha, economic profitability, causality, universal cross-asset superiority, or Tail-F1 benefit. A failed primary gate must be reported as failed confirmation.
